Class ResearchService

java.lang.Object
services.BaseService<SerializableModel>
services.ResearchService
public class ResearchService extends BaseService<SerializableModel>
ResearchService is a concrete service. It implements logic for researcher profiles and research papers (two repositories), including co-authors, references, citations, and automatically creates researcher profile for some user classses.
